Remarks

Use this type when a manifest is loaded from an external endpoint so the source can be recorded alongside the parsed manifest data.

Properties

SourceUrl

Gets the URL of the remote source from which this manifest was obtained. This lets you know where it came from if you want to know more about the plugin, making sure you get it from the same place.
